resolved_conflicts.explanation: Canada Lookouts gives a 1963 annual report entry about a tower cabin. The Firetowers page gives 1965 twice in its notes, unlabelled. The two are not joined in the story: the 1963 entry is about the cabin, and the 1965 figure is not explained by any source read.

notes_for_editor: Two sources give almost nothing on this tower: a single 1963 annual report line about a cabin, and the Firetowers pages. The brief has no height, construction year or access. The Firetowers page leaves the height and construction-year fields blank for Mistohay and prints 1965 twice in its notes with no label; the story does not treat 1965 as a construction date. The annual report entry concerns a tower cabin, so the tower's own build date is unknown. John Rule's entry carries no dates. The brief's agency (SPSA) is not named in any source read; the story uses the agency the annual report names. Wikipedia's Mistohay Lake article, in Meadow Lake Provincial Park, was checked for tower mentions and had none, so the story does not connect the two. Search found no other source.
